newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S MEZOGEP SUBSCRIPTION PRICE SET HUF 1,880.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S MEZOGEP SUBSCRIPTION PRICE SET HUF 1,880.

text.p: The subscription price in an upcoming share issue in Hungarian agricultural machinery company Mezogazdasagi Gepgyarto Rt (Mezogep) was set at 1,880 forints/share, the official bourse gazette said on Tuesday.
The company will publicly offer 64,400 registered ordinary shares with 100 forint face value each as two board members - Marton Havasi and Janos Ivanics - sell Mezogep shares they hold, it said.
The subscription period will run from March 12 to 14.
Mezogep, majority owned by Canada's Linamar Corp, submitted its request in February to list its shares in the listed "B" category of the Budapest Stock Exchange.
CS First Boston will act as lead manager.
